purpose: Fix the class of candidate actions over which the constraint matrix (lab/process/action-constraint-matrix.json) is intersected. A statement 'no action in C hosts P1, P2 and P3 together' is only meaningful relative to this declaration.

declaration.base: Oriented smooth four-manifold X^4 carrying Lorentzian (3,1) metrics.
declaration.total_space: Y^14 = Met(X^4) with the gimmel/DeWitt fibre metric (trace-reversed Frobenius fibre, see GEOMETER-VS-PHYSICS-OBJECTS.md 'The metric'). Base and fibre metrics stay typed separately.
fields: observation section g: X^4 -> Y^14 (metric field)
connection on the chimeric spinor bundle over Y^14, structure group fixed by the declared Clifford signature
gamma-traceless Rarita-Schwinger carrier (ker Gamma) and its spin-1/2 companions
optional ad-valued one-form a in Omega^1(ad) (curvature-induced, not a separate Higgs scalar)

open_typed_parameters.clifford_signature: admitted fork {(7,7), (9,5)}; each value is a separate subclass and a matrix verdict names the subclass
open_typed_parameters.fibre_model: metric fibre GL(4,R)/O(3,1); K3-fibered family realization OPEN (canon/source-action-family-index-interface-SPEC.md)

declaration.symmetry: Natural (diffeomorphism-covariant) on X^4 and covariant under the gauge group of the declared chimeric bundle, including its inhomogeneous extension where the action uses it.
declaration.locality_and_order: Local, polynomial in field jets; bosonic principal order <= 2 (curvature-square / Shiab-contracted curvature terms); fermionic principal order <= 1 (Dirac / Rarita-Schwinger type).
declaration.coefficients: Real coefficients; no explicitly inserted integer generation multiplicity.
declaration.domain_and_boundary: Smooth on Y^14 with APS-type boundary data on the noncompact end; an a-priori Y^14 boundary connection is admitted as part of the action data.
declaration.variational_structure: Euler-Lagrange system with Noether identities; BV-extendable gauge structure.
declaration.external_data_admitted: P1, P2 and P3 may enter as typed external background or boundary data. Whether they can enter jointly is exactly what the matrix tests.

exclusions: importing chi(K3)=24, the /8 normalization, Ahat=3 or 'contractible fibre => 1' (absorbed/gu-source-action/DEAD-ENDS.md automatic fails)
actions that insert a generation integer by hand
conventional comparator actions used as evidence against source-native mechanisms (lab/methods/source-native-comparator-routing.md)

width_test.rule: C is admissible only if it is neither a strawman nor vacuous.

inclusion_witness.requirement: At least one known action satisfying P1 lies in C or in a declared comparator extension of C.
inclusion_witness.candidate: The external-by-structure index mechanism: a vectorlike interior plus a net-self-dual chiral background whose flux/instanton number sets the chiral index (canon/external-by-structure-synthesis-RESULTS.md). Used as a control only.
inclusion_witness.status: proposed; first LB-CLASS run certifies or replaces it

exclusion_witness.requirement: At least one action family in C is decided by an existing row.
exclusion_witness.candidate: Interior covariant operators that would force an odd chiral count are excluded by the structural law (linear leg theorem-grade; antilinear leg finite hunt, evidence only).
exclusion_witness.status: proposed; first LB-CLASS run certifies or replaces it

verdict_wording.empty_intersection: GU falsified within action class C vN: the declared class, tested against rows P1-P3, has empty joint intersection. Falsification-shaped for the declared class only, not a global GU verdict (same reading as lab/process/construction-space-preregistered-endings-2026-07-19.md).
verdict_wording.nonempty_intersection: Candidate action family within class C vN, with typed imports; forwarded to forward certification stage action_causal_closure.
verdict_wording.handoff: An empty intersection goes to Joe before any canon movement or public framing change.

widening_policy: Widening C after any kill requires a new version, a written reason and a degeneration_log entry before the next run uses it.
predecessor: CONSTRUCTION-SPACE-EXPLORATION (lab/process/construction-space-map.json, July 2026). Its R0/R1/R2 rungs and preregistered endings are reused; this class declaration narrows that program to the external-datum rows.
